title: The Decoy
concept: A decoy lures an enemy piece — often the king — onto a square where a tactic is waiting for it. You usually give something up to set the trap.
tip: Ask which square would be terrible for an enemy piece, then find a check or capture that drags it there.

feedback.correct: Great trap! You lured the piece onto a bad square and the tactic did the rest — that is a decoy.
feedback.hint: Is there a square where the enemy king or a piece would walk into a fork or a check?
feedback.reveal: Sacrifice to pull the piece onto the fatal square, then strike with the follow-up move.
